sourceTitle: Dæmonologia Sacra; or, A Treatise of Satan's Temptations In Three Parts
description: "Dæmonologia Sacra; or, A Treatise of Satan's Temptations" by Richard Gilpin is a theological treatise written in the late 17th century. This work explores the nature of Satan's temptations, detailing his malice, power, and cunning as he seeks to lead individuals astray.
